title: specific "Monorepo Gitignore Improvements" prompt breaks Claude Code
body:
**Bug Description**
> please look through all the local changes we have in this monorepo, then fix up our gitignores with any issues you see

⏺ I'll examine the local changes and fix up the gitignore files. Let me check the current status first.

⏺ Bash…

✽ Marinating… (2s · esc to interrupt)

╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ >                                                                                                                                                                                      │
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
  ! for bash mode · / for commands · esc to undo                                                                                                                   shift + ⏎ for newline


This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block, or by rejecting a promise which was not handled with .catch(). The promise rejected with the reason:

  Bash…

✳ Marinating… (12s · esc to interrupt)

- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 0.2.32
